name: Town
about: The town square you can walk in (Nov 17). One tile is 40 px of the 932x430 town picture (the game draws it at 48 px a tile). # = can't walk (buildings, trees, the river, the statue, flower boxes, the weapon rack), . = street, P = where you come out of your own dojo. Walk into the grey house's door to go home, or the Action Zone's door to visit the real dojo.
